s.note: the loss to Australia nobody forgets
s.how: Peel 600g taro and slice paper thin on a mandoline. Fry in batches at 175C for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and pale golden. Drain and toss with 1 tsp salt mixed with the zest of 1 lime and 1/2 tsp chilli flakes.

s.note: raw fish salad, the island way
s.how: Cut 400g very fresh white fish fillets into 1cm cubes and cover with the juice of 4 limes. Chill 30 minutes until the fish turns white. Drain most of the juice, then stir in 200ml coconut cream, 1 diced cucumber, 2 diced tomatoes and half a finely diced red onion. Season and serve cold.

m.note: Samoan chop suey for the whole squad
m.how: Soak 250g glass noodles in hot water for 10 minutes and drain. Fry 600g sliced chicken thighs with 3 garlic cloves and a thumb of ginger until browned, then add 2 sliced carrots and 1 onion. Add the noodles, 80ml soy sauce and 250ml water and toss until the noodles soak it all up.

w.note: coconut buns baked in coconut cream
w.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 50g soft butter and 300ml warm water into a dough and prove 1 hour. Shape 12 buns into a baking dish. Mix 400ml coconut cream with 100g sugar, pour over and bake at 180C for 30 minutes until golden and sticky.

d.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate into 500ml hot water, then whisk in 500ml milk and 3 tbsp sugar and heat until steaming. Serve hot in mugs, or cool it down and pour over ice for a hot afternoon.
